fields.FIR_Description: As per the complaint recorded on 2025-08-01, several unauthorised transfers totalling Rs. 1,85,000 were noticed in the account of the complainant. The time of the incident was given as 10:30 on 2025-07-31. The online submission was made by Kishore Krishnan (9000000246). Transactions from the account SYN-ACC-100056, held by the complainant, were referred to in the complaint. Sathish Sundaram (mobile 9000000372) was named as a possible person of interest. Prakash Muthu (9000000312), described as a neighbour, was also mentioned in the complaint. Items referenced in the complaint: transaction records and a bank transaction reference. Records suggest a possible link with FIR-2026-00139, as the mobile number 9000000372 is associated with a suspect in both entries.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Victim reported unauthorised debits after sharing details during a call.
fields.Keywords: bank fraud, unauthorised transaction, associate, bank reference, residential colony, suspect, transaction record, mobile number
